LEGACY.finding: CA compares IN-SITU density at each level pressure (no potential-density criterion). Under EOS-80, compressibility over 50 dbar can exceed the thermal contrast, so a genuinely convective (potential-density-unstable) column is falsely declared stable and left unmixed. Not fixed in T2.

finding: CA uses IN-SITU density at the local depth. Under EOS-80, compressibility over 50 dbar can exceed the thermal destabilisation, so a column that is genuinely convective in potential density is classified as stable and left unmixed. This is the A-1 defect (false stability). It is documented for the CA/EOS fix; NOT changed in T2.
